title: Flags and abbreviations

location.extent: Complete published video; PNG is one poster frame

slide_intent: Combine pictorial and textual identifiers so people have more than one cue for recognizing a place or money context.
strategic_value: Repeated circular flags and colored labels can help Wise’s international scope feel systematic.
demonstration: A circular flag turns beside a rounded label as the pair cycles through examples including ZMB, UGA, HRV, NPL, BRL, BWA and CYP.
practical_value: Check label semantics before reuse: this demonstration mixes country-style identifiers with BRL, a currency code.
